sn35.109:1.1: saññojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saññojanañca
sn35.109:1.3: katame ca bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā? katamañca saññojanaṃ?
sn35.109:1.5: yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ, sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.109:1.6: jivhā saññojaniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ kāyo …pe…
sn35.109:1.8: yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ.
sn35.109:1.9: ime vuccanti bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā, idaṃ saññojananti.
